import argparse
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    df = pd.read_csv(f"{args.input}/previous_data.csv")

    # ASSERTION_START
    allowed_targets = {"Graduate", "Dropout", "Enrolled"}
    assert df["Target"].isin(allowed_targets).all()
    assert allowed_targets.issubset(set(df["Target"].unique()))
    target_share = df["Target"].value_counts(normalize=True)
    g = target_share.get("Graduate", 0.0)
    d = target_share.get("Dropout", 0.0)
    e = target_share.get("Enrolled", 0.0)
    assert (0.45 <= g <= 0.55) and (0.28 <= d <= 0.35) and (0.15 <= e <= 0.22)
    # ASSERTION_END

    dropout_prior = df["Target"].eq("Dropout").mean()

    # ASSERTION_START
    ao = df["Application order"].astype(float)
    assert ((ao >= 1) & (ao <= 9)).all()
    assert (df["Application order"].eq(1).mean()) >= 0.60
    assert 7 <= df["Application order"].nunique() <= 9
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    fees = df["Tuition fees up to date"].astype(int)
    debt = df["Debtor"].astype(int)
    assert set(fees.unique()).issubset({0, 1})
    assert set(debt.unique()).issubset({0, 1})
    assert not ((debt == 1) & (fees == 1)).any()
    assert ((fees == 1) <= (debt == 0)).all()
    assert (fees.mean()) >= 0.85
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    gdp = df["GDP"].astype(float)
    ur = df["Unemployment rate"].astype(float)
    inf = df["Inflation rate"].astype(float)
    assert ((ur >= 5) & (ur <= 25)).all()
    assert ((inf >= -2) & (inf <= 5)).all()
    assert ((gdp >= -6) & (gdp <= 6)).all()
    assert 9 <= gdp.nunique() <= 11
    assert 9 <= ur.nunique() <= 11
    assert 8 <= inf.nunique() <= 10
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    adm = df["Admission grade"].astype(float)
    prev = df["Previous qualification (grade)"].astype(float)
    assert ((adm >= 0) & (adm <= 200)).all()
    assert ((prev >= 0) & (prev <= 200)).all()
    corr_ap = np.corrcoef(adm, prev)[0, 1]
    assert corr_ap > 0.2
    adr = adm * 10
    assert np.isclose(adr, np.round(adr)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Cross-field consistency used for safe rate computations and filtering
    e1_all = df["Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)"].astype(float)
    a1_all = df["Curricular units 1st sem (approved)"].astype(float)
    c1_all = df["Curricular units 1st sem (credited)"].astype(float)
    w1_all = df["Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)"].astype(float)
    g1_all = df["Curricular units 1st sem (grade)"].astype(float)

    e2_all = df["Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)"].astype(float)
    a2_all = df["Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)"].astype(float)
    c2_all = df["Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)"].astype(float)
    w2_all = df["Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)"].astype(float)
    g2_all = df["Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)"].astype(float)

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (e1_all >= 0).all() and (a1_all >= 0).all() and (c1_all >= 0).all() and (w1_all >= 0).all()
    assert (a1_all <= e1_all).all() and (c1_all <= e1_all).all() and (w1_all <= e1_all).all()
    assert ((g1_all >= 0) & (g1_all <= 20)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (e2_all >= 0).all() and (a2_all >= 0).all() and (c2_all >= 0).all() and (w2_all >= 0).all()
    assert (a2_all <= e2_all).all() and (c2_all <= e2_all).all() and (w2_all <= e2_all).all()
    assert ((g2_all >= 0) & (g2_all <= 20)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    mask_enrolled = df["Target"].eq("Enrolled")
    mask_grad = df["Target"].eq("Graduate")
    assert ((e1_all[mask_enrolled] + e2_all[mask_enrolled]) > 0).all()
    assert ((a1_all[mask_grad] + a2_all[mask_grad]) > 0).all()
    zero_enroll = (e1_all.eq(0) & e2_all.eq(0))
    assert (df.loc[zero_enroll, "Target"].eq("Dropout")).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    current = df[df["Target"] == "Enrolled"].copy()

    # Re-materialize required columns for current students
    e1 = current["Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)"].astype(float)
    a1 = current["Curricular units 1st sem (approved)"].astype(float)
    c1 = current["Curricular units 1st sem (credited)"].astype(float)
    w1 = current["Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)"].astype(float)
    g1 = current["Curricular units 1st sem (grade)"].astype(float)

    e2 = current["Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)"].astype(float)
    a2 = current["Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)"].astype(float)
    c2 = current["Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)"].astype(float)
    w2 = current["Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)"].astype(float)
    g2 = current["Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)"].astype(float)

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (e1 + e2 > 0).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Engagement and performance features
    pace1 = np.divide(a1, e1, out=np.zeros_like(a1, dtype=float), where=e1 > 0)
    pace2 = np.divide(a2, e2, out=np.zeros_like(a2, dtype=float), where=e2 > 0)

    credit1 = np.divide(c1, e1, out=np.zeros_like(c1, dtype=float), where=e1 > 0)
    credit2 = np.divide(c2, e2, out=np.zeros_like(c2, dtype=float), where=e2 > 0)

    no_eval1 = np.divide(w1, e1, out=np.zeros_like(w1, dtype=float), where=e1 > 0)
    no_eval2 = np.divide(w2, e2, out=np.zeros_like(w2, dtype=float), where=e2 > 0)

    grade_norm = (g1.fillna(0) + g2.fillna(0)) / 40.0

    # Financial and application features
    fees_c = current["Tuition fees up to date"].astype(int)
    debt_c = current["Debtor"].astype(int)
    app_ord_c = current["Application order"].astype(float)

    payment_risk = (1 - fees_c) + (0.5 * debt_c)
    app_risk = (app_ord_c > 1).astype(float)

    # Macro adjustment features
    ur_c = current["Unemployment rate"].astype(float)
    inf_c = current["Inflation rate"].astype(float)
    gdp_c = current["GDP"].astype(float)

    ur_norm = (ur_c - 5.0) / 20.0
    inf_norm = (inf_c + 2.0) / 7.0
    gdp_stress = np.clip(-gdp_c / 6.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    macro_stress = (0.5 * ur_norm) + (0.2 * inf_norm) + (0.3 * gdp_stress)

    # Academic preparedness and consistency
    adm_c = current["Admission grade"].astype(float)
    prev_c = current["Previous qualification (grade)"].astype(float)
    prep = (adm_c + prev_c) / 400.0
    # consistency penalty based on scale alignment
    z_adm = (adm_c - adm.mean()) / (adm.std(ddof=0) if adm.std(ddof=0) != 0 else 1.0)
    z_prev = (prev_c - prev.mean()) / (prev.std(ddof=0) if prev.std(ddof=0) != 0 else 1.0)
    consistency_penalty = np.minimum(np.abs(z_adm - z_prev) / 4.0, 1.0)

    engagement = (pace1 + pace2) / 2.0
    credit_ratio = (credit1 + credit2) / 2.0
    no_eval_ratio = (no_eval1 + no_eval2) / 2.0

    base = dropout_prior
    risk = (
        base
        + 0.30 * (1.0 - engagement)
        + 0.15 * (1.0 - credit_ratio)
        + 0.15 * no_eval_ratio
        + 0.18 * payment_risk
        + 0.05 * app_risk
        + 0.12 * (1.0 - grade_norm)
        + 0.10 * (1.0 - prep)
        + 0.10 * consistency_penalty
        + 0.08 * macro_stress
    )

    risk = np.clip(risk, 0.0, 1.0)

    out = current.copy()
    out["dropout_risk_score"] = risk
    out = out[[
        "dropout_risk_score",
        "Target",
        "Application order",
        "Debtor",
        "Tuition fees up to date",
        "Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)",
        "Curricular units 1st sem (approved)",
        "Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)",
        "Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)",
        "Curricular units 1st sem (grade)",
        "Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)",
        "Unemployment rate",
        "Inflation rate",
        "GDP",
        "Admission grade",
        "Previous qualification (grade)"
    ]]

    out_path = f"{args.output}/weekly_dropout_risk_scores.csv"
    out.to_csv(out_path, index_label="student_row_id")


if __name__ == "__main__":

import argparse
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    df = pd.read_csv(f"{args.input}/previous_data.csv")

    # ASSERTION_START
    allowed_targets = {"Graduate", "Dropout", "Enrolled"}
    assert df["Target"].isin(allowed_targets).all()
    assert allowed_targets.issubset(set(df["Target"].unique()))
    target_share = df["Target"].value_counts(normalize=True)
    g = target_share.get("Graduate", 0.0)
    d = target_share.get("Dropout", 0.0)
    e = target_share.get("Enrolled", 0.0)
    assert (0.45 <= g <= 0.55) and (0.28 <= d <= 0.35) and (0.15 <= e <= 0.22)
    # ASSERTION_END

    dropout_prior = df["Target"].eq("Dropout").mean()

    # ASSERTION_START
    ao = df["Application order"].astype(float)
    assert ((ao >= 1) & (ao <= 9)).all()
    assert (df["Application order"].eq(1).mean()) >= 0.60
    assert 7 <= df["Application order"].nunique() <= 9
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    fees = df["Tuition fees up to date"].astype(int)
    debt = df["Debtor"].astype(int)
    assert set(fees.unique()).issubset({0, 1})
    assert set(debt.unique()).issubset({0, 1})
    assert not ((debt == 1) & (fees == 1)).any()
    assert ((fees == 1) <= (debt == 0)).all()
    assert (fees.mean()) >= 0.85
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    gdp = df["GDP"].astype(float)
    ur = df["Unemployment rate"].astype(float)
    inf = df["Inflation rate"].astype(float)
    assert ((ur >= 5) & (ur <= 25)).all()
    assert ((inf >= -2) & (inf <= 5)).all()
    assert ((gdp >= -6) & (gdp <= 6)).all()
    assert 9 <= gdp.nunique() <= 11
    assert 9 <= ur.nunique() <= 11
    assert 8 <= inf.nunique() <= 10
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    adm = df["Admission grade"].astype(float)
    prev = df["Previous qualification (grade)"].astype(float)
    assert ((adm >= 0) & (adm <= 200)).all()
    assert ((prev >= 0) & (prev <= 200)).all()
    corr_ap = np.corrcoef(adm, prev)[0, 1]
    assert corr_ap > 0.2
    adr = adm * 10
    assert np.isclose(adr, np.round(adr)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Cross-field consistency used for safe rate computations and filtering
    e1_all = df["Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)"].astype(float)
    a1_all = df["Curricular units 1st sem (approved)"].astype(float)
    c1_all = df["Curricular units 1st sem (credited)"].astype(float)
    w1_all = df["Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)"].astype(float)
    g1_all = df["Curricular units 1st sem (grade)"].astype(float)

    e2_all = df["Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)"].astype(float)
    a2_all = df["Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)"].astype(float)
    c2_all = df["Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)"].astype(float)
    w2_all = df["Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)"].astype(float)
    g2_all = df["Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)"].astype(float)

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (e1_all >= 0).all() and (a1_all >= 0).all() and (c1_all >= 0).all() and (w1_all >= 0).all()
    assert (a1_all <= e1_all).all() and (c1_all <= e1_all).all() and (w1_all <= e1_all).all()
    assert ((g1_all >= 0) & (g1_all <= 20)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (e2_all >= 0).all() and (a2_all >= 0).all() and (c2_all >= 0).all() and (w2_all >= 0).all()
    assert (a2_all <= e2_all).all() and (c2_all <= e2_all).all() and (w2_all <= e2_all).all()
    assert ((g2_all >= 0) & (g2_all <= 20)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    mask_enrolled = df["Target"].eq("Enrolled")
    mask_grad = df["Target"].eq("Graduate")
    assert ((e1_all[mask_enrolled] + e2_all[mask_enrolled]) > 0).all()
    assert ((a1_all[mask_grad] + a2_all[mask_grad]) > 0).all()
    zero_enroll = (e1_all.eq(0) & e2_all.eq(0))
    assert (df.loc[zero_enroll, "Target"].eq("Dropout")).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    current = df[df["Target"] == "Enrolled"].copy()

    # Re-materialize required columns for current students
    e1 = current["Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)"].astype(float)
    a1 = current["Curricular units 1st sem (approved)"].astype(float)
    c1 = current["Curricular units 1st sem (credited)"].astype(float)
    w1 = current["Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)"].astype(float)
    g1 = current["Curricular units 1st sem (grade)"].astype(float)

    e2 = current["Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)"].astype(float)
    a2 = current["Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)"].astype(float)
    c2 = current["Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)"].astype(float)
    w2 = current["Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)"].astype(float)
    g2 = current["Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)"].astype(float)

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (e1 + e2 > 0).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Engagement and performance features
    pace1 = np.divide(a1, e1, out=np.zeros_like(a1, dtype=float), where=e1 > 0)
    pace2 = np.divide(a2, e2, out=np.zeros_like(a2, dtype=float), where=e2 > 0)

    credit1 = np.divide(c1, e1, out=np.zeros_like(c1, dtype=float), where=e1 > 0)
    credit2 = np.divide(c2, e2, out=np.zeros_like(c2, dtype=float), where=e2 > 0)

    no_eval1 = np.divide(w1, e1, out=np.zeros_like(w1, dtype=float), where=e1 > 0)
    no_eval2 = np.divide(w2, e2, out=np.zeros_like(w2, dtype=float), where=e2 > 0)

    grade_norm = (g1.fillna(0) + g2.fillna(0)) / 40.0

    # Financial and application features
    fees_c = current["Tuition fees up to date"].astype(int)
    debt_c = current["Debtor"].astype(int)
    app_ord_c = current["Application order"].astype(float)

    payment_risk = (1 - fees_c) + (0.5 * debt_c)
    app_risk = (app_ord_c > 1).astype(float)

    # Macro adjustment features
    ur_c = current["Unemployment rate"].astype(float)
    inf_c = current["Inflation rate"].astype(float)
    gdp_c = current["GDP"].astype(float)

    ur_norm = (ur_c - 5.0) / 20.0
    inf_norm = (inf_c + 2.0) / 7.0
    gdp_stress = np.clip(-gdp_c / 6.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    macro_stress = (0.5 * ur_norm) + (0.2 * inf_norm) + (0.3 * gdp_stress)

    # Academic preparedness and consistency
    adm_c = current["Admission grade"].astype(float)
    prev_c = current["Previous qualification (grade)"].astype(float)
    prep = (adm_c + prev_c) / 400.0
    # consistency penalty based on scale alignment
    z_adm = (adm_c - adm.mean()) / (adm.std(ddof=0) if adm.std(ddof=0) != 0 else 1.0)
    z_prev = (prev_c - prev.mean()) / (prev.std(ddof=0) if prev.std(ddof=0) != 0 else 1.0)
    consistency_penalty = np.minimum(np.abs(z_adm - z_prev) / 4.0, 1.0)

    engagement = (pace1 + pace2) / 2.0
    credit_ratio = (credit1 + credit2) / 2.0
    no_eval_ratio = (no_eval1 + no_eval2) / 2.0

    base = dropout_prior
    risk = (
        base
        + 0.30 * (1.0 - engagement)
        + 0.15 * (1.0 - credit_ratio)
        + 0.15 * no_eval_ratio
        + 0.18 * payment_risk
        + 0.05 * app_risk
        + 0.12 * (1.0 - grade_norm)
        + 0.10 * (1.0 - prep)
        + 0.10 * consistency_penalty
        + 0.08 * macro_stress
    )

    risk = np.clip(risk, 0.0, 1.0)

    out = current.copy()
    out["dropout_risk_score"] = risk
    out = out[[
        "dropout_risk_score",
        "Target",
        "Application order",
        "Debtor",
        "Tuition fees up to date",
        "Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)",
        "Curricular units 1st sem (approved)",
        "Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)",
        "Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)",
        "Curricular units 1st sem (grade)",
        "Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)",
        "Unemployment rate",
        "Inflation rate",
        "GDP",
        "Admission grade",
        "Previous qualification (grade)"
    ]]

    out_path = f"{args.output}/weekly_dropout_risk_scores.csv"
    out.to_csv(out_path, index_label="student_row_id")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
